agg = (
    df.groupby(['id_reef', 'year', 'depth'])
      .agg(
          crypt_prod=('prod', lambda x: x[df.loc[x.index, 'crypt']].sum()),
          total_prod=('prod', 'sum')
      )
      .reset_index()
)
agg['prop_crypt'] = agg['crypt_prod'] / agg['total_prod']

# 4. Summary statistics by depth
summary = agg.groupby('depth')['prop_crypt'].agg(['count', 'mean', 'std', 'min', 'median', 'max'])

t_res = stats.ttest_rel(shallow, deep)
print(f"Paired t-test (Shallow vs Deep): t = {t_res.statistic:.3f}, p = {t_res.pvalue:.3e}\n")
